heading: Firearms, fireworks, speeches, and objectionable language in the Supreme Court Building and grounds
lead: It is unlawful to discharge a firearm, firework or explosive, set fire to a combustible, make a harangue or oration, or utter loud, threatening, or abusive language in the Supreme Court Building or grounds.
